payload.title: Real-replay live-fusion mesh v2 with observability-first evidence
payload.work_clay: Before adjudicating broadcast vs tag-only vs adaptive routing, persist or reproducibly reconstruct for every replayed delta: source observation identity, KnowledgeDelta identity, semantic epoch, pre-route BranchDependencyIndex projection hash/snapshot, declared causal predecessors, each policy RoutePlan, receiver delivery/reconstruction/use/local-or-research-effect closure, resulting research reentry effect, payload bytes, latency/resource shadows, repair/rollback state and exact-vs-approximate-priority lane identity. Then run matched sparse/local and dense/high-centrality cases plus missing-edge, stale-epoch, duplicate, causal-reorder and crash/restart faults. A post-hoc affected-branch set alone is an oracle baseline and must not count as candidate recall evidence.
payload.reason_clay: The 16:25 continuous-reentry delta correctly extends fusion through explicit research reentry, but the newest durable 15:56 fusion event only exposes post-hoc branch DELTA/NO_CHANGE outcomes. That event shows a 4-of-9 oracle affected set, implying a 55.6% theoretical full-payload reduction versus broadcast, yet it does not preserve the candidate pre-route dependency projection, RoutePlan or full FusionReceipt chain needed to score actual adaptive recall, route-cost error or repair. Current primary incremental-computation research supports adaptive strategy selection but cannot substitute for this missing real-repo observability.
payload.completion_clay: Matched replay report contains exact repo/head/semantic-epoch hashes; pre-route dependency snapshot or reproducible reconstruction refs; per-policy RoutePlans; adjudicated affected-set ground truth separated from policy prediction; delivered/reconstructed/used/effect/reentry receipts; payload and digest bytes; route-cost prediction error; invalidation and repair latency; false interrupt/miss counts; exact-vs-shadow authority checks; missing/stale/duplicate/reorder/restart fault receipts; and explicit SUPPORTED/REFUTED/REVISE/NO_CHANGE verdict. No candidate or BASE promotion from post-hoc oracle relevance alone.
payload.executor_policy: Keep WORK-CLAYCODE-BASE14-CLOSE-20260809 on the BASE critical path. Execute this revision with spare capable capacity or when instrumentation directly improves current work-state/ClayGraph/UnifiedDB observability. Refresh repo head and work revision before every material effect. No paid training. Frank self-Harness authority remains proposal-only.
invalidators: A newer owner-fixed mesh protocol supersedes live-fusion v2.
A newer verified execution receipt already runs the same observability-complete matched replay and fault matrix.
Current runtime proves BranchDependencyIndex/RoutePlan/FusionReceipt observability is available through an equivalent durable surface.
